Recorded claim:
D209025 review found that broad tree style changes broke message drag behavior and hid the more and star controls, even though the address book cards looked right. The browser_cardsView.js test already checked the star and card dimensions, and review sent the author to the old thread-row selectors to restore drag. After changing selectors shared by message and address book trees, verify drag, visible actions, and semantic row roles as well as visual states. The accepted final patch retained draggable row setup.
